# 404 Not Found

> Ad-free, server-less browser utilities. Everything runs in your browser — no ads, no servers, no sign-up.

## About

404 Not Found is a collection of small, focused web utilities. Every tool runs
entirely client-side in your browser using JavaScript — your data is never
uploaded and never leaves your device. No ads, no sign-up, no noise.

Hosted at oxvx.github.io on GitHub Pages.

## The point

- No ads — no banners, cookie consent walls, or newsletter pop-ups
- No servers — all processing happens in the browser, so results are instant
- No noise — no login, no sign-up; open a tool and use it

## Tools

- [QR code](https://oxvx.github.io/qr-code): Generate QR codes for URLs, text, email, phone, SMS, WiFi, contacts (vCard), location, events, and app links. Custom colors, gradients, dot shapes, and a center logo. Export as PNG, SVG, JPEG, or WebP.
- [Image redact](https://oxvx.github.io/image-redact): Hide parts of an image by drawing regions and applying blur, pixelate, or a solid black box. Drag to move, resize by corner handles, with per-region effects. Exported images have their EXIF/GPS metadata removed. Export as PNG.

More tools are in progress across image, file, text, code, convert, encode, and
generate categories.
